input_bytes.definition: v1: input address bytes passed to parser, excluding line terminators

normalized_bytes.definition: v1: normalized address bytes emitted by the instrumented normalization boundary, excluding NUL

tokens.definition: v1: tokens emitted by the instrumented tokenizer during parsing

output_bytes.definition: v1: response bytes produced at the instrumented response-build boundary; excludes terminator

keys_constructed.reason: no complete count of intermediate lookup key construction sites

bytes_copied.reason: parser text copy/append sites are not comprehensively instrumented

model_rows.definition: v1: state and transition feature weight rows visited at instrumented accumulation sites

weights_accumulated.definition: v1: state and transition feature weight contributions added at instrumented accumulation sites

token_record_requested_bytes.definition: 201 diagnostic: requested bytes for token-record vector growth, computed as new capacity times sizeof(token_t).

char_buffer_requested_bytes.definition: 201 diagnostic: exact byte requests passed to realloc at instrumented char-array growth sites, grouped by token_payload or normalized_text.

token_payload_used_peak_bytes.definition: 201 diagnostic: maximum token cstring payload-buffer used length during parsing; includes per-token NULs.

token_payload_capacity_peak_bytes.definition: 201 diagnostic: maximum retained capacity of the token cstring payload buffer during parsing.

token_offset_used_peak_entries.definition: 201 diagnostic: maximum used offset-vector entries during parsing.

token_offset_capacity_peak_entries.definition: 201 diagnostic: maximum retained offset-vector capacity during parsing.

token_record_used_peak_entries.definition: 201 diagnostic: maximum used token-record entries during parsing.

token_record_capacity_peak_entries.definition: 201 diagnostic: maximum retained token-record capacity during parsing.

normalized_text_used_peak_bytes.definition: 201 diagnostic: maximum reusable normalized-text buffer length during parsing; includes its terminating NUL.

normalized_text_capacity_peak_bytes.definition: 201 diagnostic: maximum retained capacity of the reusable normalized-text buffer during parsing.
